zh-CN.title: 本地检索示例
zh-CN.description: 使用固定示例文档演示只读检索与结构化工具结果，不连接外部知识库。

usage.title: 在对话里试一次检索
usage.description: 让 Agent 使用本地检索示例搜索 release，查看匹配到的固定演示文档。

usage.title: 检查返回结果
usage.description: 观察文字摘要与结构化工具成果；示例数据是虚构的，不代表真实知识库内容。

en-US.title: Local retrieval example
en-US.description: Demonstrate read-only retrieval and structured tool results using fixed sample documents, without an external knowledge service.

usage.title: Try a search in chat
usage.description: Ask the Agent to use the local retrieval example to search for release and inspect the matching demonstration document.

usage.title: Inspect the result
usage.description: Review its text summary and structured tool artifact. The fixed corpus is synthetic, not a real knowledge base.
